title: Tissue transglutaminase 2 in Celiac disease pathogenesis
abstract: Celiac disease is an autoimmune enteropathy triggered by dietary gluten. Tissue transglutaminase 2 (tTG2) deamidates gluten peptides, increasing their binding affinity to HLA-DQ2/DQ8 receptors.

title: HLA-DQ2 and HLA-DQ8 presentation of gluten epitopes
abstract: HLA-DQ2 and HLA-DQ8 molecules on antigen-presenting cells present deamidated gluten peptides to CD4+ T cells, inducing mucosal inflammation and villous atrophy in the small intestine.
